description:
Sectioned briefing: central banks, macro, energy, equities, crypto, geopolitics. Groups news of the last N hours (1-48, default 24) into central_banks, macro, energy, equities, crypto and geopolitics by keyword rules (an item may appear in several), each with count, high_count and up to 5 headlines (high first, then newest), plus top_topics of high items.

GET /news/digest — price $0.01 USDC per call, paid automatically via x402 on Base (only successful responses are charged; 400/404/502 are free).
